caption: The drawing features two primary objects set against a plain, pale beige background. The upper object is a sheath, brown in color with a slightly darker, textured rectangular section at the opening, and a strap loop at the top right. The lower object is a large knife or short sword with a broad, straight, and slightly curved silver-gray metal blade. The handle is brown, matching the sheath’s color, and is attached to a metal guard with a simple, rectangular handguard loop extending from one side. The two objects are positioned diagonally, with the sheath above and parallel to the blade, which points toward the bottom left corner. The name “William R. Ludwig” is printed in small red letters near the lower right part of the image.
title: Trench Knife and Sheath
